title: Jumpr Management Meeting - 2026/08/31 16:00 EDT - Notes by Gemini
screen_reason: Jumpr-internal management meeting. Most content is about other clients and internal operations (not recorded). Two short passages hold WagerTech delivery content: engagement status and an internal re-plan discussion (00:21:55-00:24:49), and Kobi's WagerTech project update (00:43:19-00:45:39, phase model dropped, click intake milestone, CMS integration paused), plus two brief planning references at 00:51:48-00:52:56.

items.statement: Kobi said WagerTech is not yet on a monthly engagement; the work is still mostly implementation with many moving parts, so next-month needs are hard to estimate.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: U especially with wage like we're not really on a uh like a monthly engagement yet, right? It's it's still a lot of implementation and there's a lot of moving parts.

items.topic: Impact of moving timeline to November
items.statement: Waleed referred to something having been moved to November and asked what that means: whether Jumpr needs to rescope, estimate the hours, talk to the client about it and set success criteria. The transcript does not say what was moved.
items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: what does it mean to have moved the thing to November again goes back to like if we need to rescope if we need to estimate the hours talk to them about it like have success criterias
items.note: The object moved to November is not named in this passage (possibly the go-live date; not confirmed here).

items.statement: Waleed suggested a pause to get ahead of the account with a plan (rescope and hour estimates only "if we need to"). Kobi agreed internally that it is a good time to step back and work out how September will progress and what "complete" looks like. No rescope was decided and nothing was agreed with the client.
items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: So I feel like we do not have like we do need like a pause of understanding / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah, agreed. / Kobi Kunasekaran: so it is it is a good time to like take a step back and kind of figure out what how we're going to progress with uh September and what the complete looks like.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Wager Tech Project Health: ... They agreed to pause for a strategic review to rescope work and define clear success criteria, rather than continuing with current scattered efforts (00:22:49).
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Waleed Alasadi: So I feel like we do not have like we do need like a pause of understanding / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah, agreed. / Kobi Kunasekaran: so it is it is a good time to like take a step back and kind of figure out what how we're going to progress with uh September and what the complete looks like.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary says they agreed to pause in order to rescope. In the transcript, rescoping and hour estimates are conditional ("if we need to rescope"); the agreement is only to step back and plan internally. No rescope was decided.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Kobi also noted that Cary Walkin is now picking up automation tasks, allowing for better management of project resources (00:44:35).
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I've assigned like all the automation and everything like those types of tasks to Cary until we're waiting on u additional like next steps for the actual integration itself. / Kobi Kunasekaran: he's picking up a few tickets.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary attributes the automation work to Cary Walkin. The transcript name "Cary" is likely an ASR rendering of Cedric (Kobi says "Now that Cedric's back" about the same automation work at 00:23:49, and Gemini's own Details section names Cedric there). Likely misattribution.
